Kwame Mensah  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 321 6789 | kwame.mensah@cloudpulse.startups | linkedin.com/in/kwame-mensah  

A seasoned data engineering leader with a decade of experience in designing scalable, high-availability systems for dynamic startup environments. Specialized in building cloud-native data architectures that balance performance, cost, and operational resilience. Proven ability to transition legacy systems to modern platforms while maintaining service-level agreements. Committed to fostering cross-functional collaboration and mentoring junior engineers through hands-on technical guidance.  

At CloudPulse Startups, I oversee the architecture and operations of our data pipeline infrastructure, which processes over 200M records daily. My focus has been on optimizing data ingestion workflows, ensuring real-time analytics capabilities, and maintaining compliance with stringent data governance standards. Prior to this, I led the migration of critical reporting systems to Snowflake, achieving a 99.99% SLA through rigorous testing and automation. This work required close collaboration with stakeholders to align technical solutions with business objectives.  

In my role as Lead Data Engineer at InnovateTech, I spearheaded the migration of 100+ databases to Snowflake, which involved designing a hybrid cloud architecture that reduced ETL processing time by 45%. This project required extensive data modeling to ensure schema efficiency, as well as implementing automated monitoring tools to maintain system reliability. Earlier, at DataFlow Inc., I architected cloud-native data lakes on AWS, leveraging Redshift to improve query performance by 65% while reducing compute costs by 30%. These efforts involved integrating Apache Airflow for orchestration and Kafka for real-time data streaming, which became foundational to our data pipeline.  

Technical expertise spans full-stack data engineering, with a focus on cloud platforms and distributed systems. Key competencies include:  
- **Apache Kafka**: Designed and maintained high-throughput data pipelines that process 50M+ daily transactions, ensuring low-latency ingestion for real-time analytics. Owned the integration of Kafka with Spark streaming to enable event-driven architectures.  
- **Apache Airflow**: Built and optimized orchestration workflows for ETL processes, reducing manual intervention by 70% and improving job reliability through dynamic dependency management.  
- **Databricks**: Led the implementation of a unified analytics platform, combining Delta Lake with Spark to streamline data processing and accelerate ad-hoc query performance by 50%.  
- **Data Modeling**: Spearheaded the design of dimensional schemas for Snowflake, reducing query execution time by 40% and improving data accessibility for business intelligence teams.  
- **Python**: Developed custom tools for data validation and pipeline health checks, reducing human error in data processing by 60%.  
- **Terraform**: Automated infrastructure provisioning for cloud environments, cutting deployment time by 50% and ensuring consistent configurations across development, staging, and production.  
- **Apache Spark**: Architected batch and streaming processing pipelines, optimizing job execution by leveraging partitioning strategies and caching mechanisms.  
- **Snowflake**: Central to my career, with over five years of experience in designing, scaling, and securing data warehouses. Mentored multiple teams on best practices for schema design and query optimization.  
- **Docker**: Streamlined local development environments by containerizing data pipeline components, improving deployment consistency and reducing setup time for new engineers.  
- **REST API design**: Built scalable APIs for data ingestion and reporting, ensuring seamless integration with third-party systems while maintaining strict security protocols.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Ghana, 2016
